notification_settings.title: Notification Settings
notification_settings.why_matter_desc: HealthDose needs reliable notifications to remind you about your medication schedule. Modern phones have battery optimization features that can prevent timely notifications.
notification_settings.follow_steps: Please follow the steps below to ensure you never miss important medication reminders.
notification_settings.notification_permissions_desc: Allow HealthDose to send you timely medication reminders
notification_settings.disable_battery_desc: This ensures your medication reminders arrive on time, even when the app is in the background
notification_settings.check_advanced_desc: Some devices have additional battery optimization settings that may need to be disabled
notification_settings.task_killer_title: Beware of Task Killers & Antivirus Apps
notification_settings.task_killer_desc: Apps like task killers and some antivirus apps may prevent HealthDose from sending notifications. Please add HealthDose to their whitelist or exclusion list.
notification_settings.advanced_dialog_content:
Some Android devices have additional battery optimization settings that may prevent notifications from being delivered on time.

To ensure reliable notifications:
1. Go to Settings > Apps > HealthDose
2. Tap on "Battery"
3. Select "Unrestricted" or "Don't optimize"

The exact steps may vary depending on your device manufacturer.
